decisions.statement: A count is read from the pages the workstation's checkout has.
A count of zero is a count.
Every site showing an inbox is carried the count rather than taking the count.
A carry that fails to one site does not stop the carry to another site.
The tile shows the counts Alan's workstation last took.
A count nothing can be read for is shown as no signal rather than as a zero.
The game tasks among Alan's inboxes belong to temper rather than here.
Alan's own email rules belong here.
The folder an email rule is in says whose rule that rule is.
A count stated as text is read as the number that count spells.

definition: the inboxes Alan keeps at empty

directives.name: Needs Him
directives.act: Judge every piece of Alan's mail by whether he has anything to do about it.
directives.warrant: Filing what he wanted costs him the thing; showing what he did not need costs a glance.
aids: Show him what he wants to read, not just tasks.
Archive urgent mail that asks nothing of him.

directives.name: Already Settled
directives.act: Archive mail that only reports something already settled, whoever settled it.
directives.warrant: Reading about a settled thing cannot change it, so the glance buys nothing.
aids: Do not call it settled while it can still fail.
Archive bad news he can no longer change.

directives.name: Money Goes To Jen
directives.act: Archive every automatic purchase or payment message, and forward Jen what no category rule settles.
directives.warrant: Jen manages the money, and a charge a category rule settles already reaches her in Monarch.
aids: Archive refunds and order confirmations too.
A bill still to be paid is not a payment.

directives.name: Spent Links
directives.act: Archive a sign-in link fifteen minutes after it arrives.
directives.warrant: He is already watching for a link he asked for, and it is spent minutes after it lands.
aids: Send him nothing — it files itself.
Show him a sign-in link he did not ask for.

directives.name: Ask The Account
directives.act: Archive every account statement and send it nowhere.
directives.warrant: Whatever a statement reports is on the account itself, so he reads it there rather than here.
aids: Contributions and royalties are statements too.
Show him a statement that reports a problem.

directives.name: Jen Runs The Programs
directives.act: Archive mail about the children's church programs, even when it asks for something.
directives.warrant: Jen runs them and is sent the mail herself, so a second copy in his inbox buys nothing.
aids: Primary, FSY and youth conference all count.
No church mail outside these programs is covered.

directives.name: Paid Opinions
directives.act: Archive every offer to pay Alan for his time or his expertise.
directives.warrant: He has weighed this class over years and ruled the money not worth the distraction.
aids: Expert networks and paid surveys count too.
A client hiring him is not one of these.

directives.name: Stop The Source
directives.act: Unsubscribe from marketing mail as well as archiving it.
directives.warrant: Archiving one copy leaves the sender running, so the same mail returns next week.
aids: Digests and launch announcements count too.
Never unsubscribe from a list he chose.

directives.name: After The Fact
directives.act: Archive every new sign-in and new-device notice.
directives.warrant: The notice arrives after the sign-in, so reading it changes nothing.
aids: Streaming and the children's accounts count too.
Show him a sign-in waiting on his approval.

directives.name: One Copy
directives.act: Archive a mailing that reached another of his addresses already, whoever it was addressed to.
directives.warrant: Every persona address routes to his one mailbox, so a list he joined once arrives many times over.
aids: The first copy through is the one he keeps.
A reply in a thread is not a second copy.
